advancement_gate: Model correctness, valid timing, earlier enqueue, no lower actual admissions and no extra compute rounds versus control; a useful throughput point estimate. One canary cell does not establish a speedup. If no candidate passes, report the failed gate and do not launch the larger comparison.
full_cohort_constraint: 300 unique 61440-token prompts exceed the unchanged 1984 GiB CPU cache. A subsequent continuous 300-request comparison needs a shorter prompt workload or an explicitly designed prefix-reuse protocol that excludes GPU hits.
